It supports new Python 3.15 language… The post CodeQL 2.27.3 adds Python 3.15 features and JSON data extensions appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: CodeQL is the static analysis engine behind GitHub code scanning, which finds and remediates security issues in your code. It supports new Python 3.15 language features, adds JSON syntax for data extensions, adds C23 bit-precise integers, and includes accuracy improvements across languages.
takeaways: Python The py/xxe , py/xml-bomb , and py/nosql-injection queries now respect your configured threat model when selecting untrusted data sources.
We’ve added an opt-in ai threat model for LLM-generated data.
We’ve added support for the new frozendict and sentinel builtins introduced in Python 3.15, including data flow modeling for frozendict construction.
